title: Acts — Acknowledging Receipt Is Not Agreeing
note: Most systems conflate these two, and the conflation is expensive in exactly one direction: reading an acknowledgement as an agreement manufactures consent nobody gave. 'Got it, thanks' and 'Received — I'll review this week' move no obligation at all, which is why the vocabulary gives that state its own wire value rather than leaving it to fall through to a generic terminal. An agent negotiating on a human's behalf must be able to say 'I have seen this and I am not bound' in a word a stranger's agent will read the same way.
